title: Hammer Curl
summary: Dumbbell curl with palms facing in: biceps and forearms 0.8. The neutral grip shares the work with the brachialis and brachioradialis.

muscles.why: The elbow flexors bend the elbow. With palms in, the biceps has less leverage, so the brachialis and brachioradialis do more; the app groups them as biceps and forearms (0.8).
The brachioradialis, a forearm muscle, flexes the elbow best with a neutral grip (0.8).

setup.text: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.

form_cues.why: Keeping the thumbs up holds the neutral grip.
Elbows still keeps the work on the elbow flexors.
Full extension at the bottom is the stretch.

form_cues.cue: Curl across the body if it feels smoother
form_cues.why: A small path change, same muscles.

bias_tweaks.effect: A short rest for each arm; may allow a slightly heavier load.

bias_tweaks.change: Lower in 2-3 seconds and pause briefly in the stretch
bias_tweaks.effect: Keeps tension on in the lengthened position and removes bounce, so each rep starts honestly.
bias_tweaks.caveat: Rep speeds from 0.5 to 8 s gave similar growth; this is a control tool, not a growth trick.

mistakes.text: Swinging the dumbbells across the body.
mistakes.fix: Lighten until the torso stays still.

misconceptions.myth: Hammer curls don't work the biceps.
misconceptions.reality: The biceps still helps; it is rated 0.8.

misconceptions.myth: Every set has to go to failure to grow.
misconceptions.reality: Stopping a few reps short gave similar growth to failure in a meta-analysis; growth tends to rise as sets get closer to failure, but the exact curve is uncertain.

lower_risk.text: The app adds no ramp-up sets here. If the muscle is not warm from earlier work, make the first set a little lighter.

Add load in small steps. The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first, up to 2 past the top of the range. Default steps for this equipment are 2 kg or 5 lb; your gym profile can replace them.
Aim for about 2 reps in reserve in the 10-15 rep range. Low-risk to push close to failure.
Pick a variation, range and setup you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Arm behind the body for a long-length biceps curl.

notes: Grip effects on curl growth have not been compared in a study the app cites.
Ratings and display bands are the library model (main >= 0.75, helper 0.4 to < 0.75, minor 0.25 to < 0.4, not counted < 0.25).
Technique and load management only. This page makes no medical or injury claims.
